en_title: Aligning the Invisible to Harmonise Daily Life
en_excerpt: Chakras and crystals, ancestral symbolism and energetic sensitivity: an invitation to pause and reconnect with yourself.
en_meta_description: How work with chakras and crystals can restore balance, calm and self-knowledge in a fast-paced world.
en_content:
Text: Janine Meira Henriques

Holistic Therapist, writer, playwright, artist, photographer, journalist, mother of 4 children.

Training: Degree – journalism, performing arts, holistic therapies, courses  including reiki, radionics, Access Bars, astrology and tarot. Psychology degree in progress, completion due in June 2026.  

Postgraduate studies: Brazilian literature, human sexuality.

 

In recent years, integrative practices that bring together spirituality and personal care have been gaining ground in conversations about quality of life. Among them, work with chakras and crystals stands out for combining ancestral symbolism, energetic sensitivity and an invitation to self-knowledge.

 

The chakras, subtle energy centres distributed throughout the body, are traditionally associated with different physical, emotional and spiritual aspects of the human being. When these centres are in balance, the vital flow tends to circulate more freely, favouring a feeling of lightness, mental clarity and emotional stability. When blockages are present, feelings of anxiety, excessive tiredness or difficulty in expressing emotions may arise.

 

It is in this context that crystals come in as natural allies. Each stone has a vibration of its own, formed over thousands of years by pressure and by the elements of the earth. When placed close to the body or used during moments of meditation, they can act as energetic catalysts, helping to release tensions and restore the harmony of the chakras.

 

For example, rose quartz is often associated with the heart chakra, stimulating compassion, empathy and self-love. Amethyst, linked to the frontal chakra, is seen as a support for intuition and mental serenity. Citrine, related to the solar plexus, inspires confidence and vitality.

 

More than a technique, aligning the chakras with crystals can be understood as a ritual of pause and presence. By dedicating a few minutes of the day to breathing, feeling and observing, a person creates an inner space of listening, reconnecting with themselves and with their deepest needs.

 

In a fast-paced world, where doing often outweighs feeling, this practice invites us to slow down and remember that balance is also born of silence, of attention and of respect for our own energy. After all, caring for the chakras is, in essence, caring for the life that pulses inside each one of us.
